recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-16431; future workflow-state modeling should be handled as a new Vocabulary decision against the current Extension Pack extension if needed.
issue_request: FHIR-16431 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification STU3 Vocabulary issue asking whether ValueSet.status should align with VSD activity status and requesting workflow status support or at least a reference from ValueSet.status documentation.
initial_application: Commit c7f83f6f3efb65e6c8622a0c7ff190a2e7790add, matching Jira's svn 14667 comment, applied GF#16431 by adding a ValueSet.status spreadsheet comment linking to the valueset-workflowStatus extension for additional editorial-process status information.
additional_context: ValueSet remains active in source/fhir.ini. Later commits b89a83b4b7fa2bec4cbaf92672d13c943c7772d5 and c3432543e2b93c3befc06f628938d37e6c1f1f02 updated the original link to the renamed workflowStatusDescription extension and canonical link syntax. The Extension Pack marks the older valueset-workflowStatus extension as retired and replaced by valueset-workflowStatusDescription. The 2018 Zulip GF#16431 thread compared VSD activity states to FHIR status values and did not identify a solid candidate for changing the shared FHIR status definitions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current ValueSet.status comment already links to valueset-workflowStatusDescription for additional status information related to the editorial process, which satisfies the applied Jira resolution without duplicating or changing the common lifecycle status semantics.
